description: This is a source file configuring the build process for Linux libc headers within a Yocto Project recipe. It defines the download source, build steps, and conditional installation logic for different architectures.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the kernel headers to the target directory and cleans up conflicting files.

methods.name: do_install_armmultilib
methods.description: Handles architecture-specific installation of headers based on major and minor version.

calls: oe_multilib_header asm/auxvec.h asm/bitsperlong.h asm/byteorder.h asm/fcntl.h asm/hwcap.h asm/ioctls.h ${ARM_KVM_HEADER} asm/kvm_para.h asm/mman.h asm/param.h asm/perf_regs.h asm/bpf_perf_event.h
oe_multilib_header asm/posix_types.h asm/ptrace.h  asm/setup.h  asm/sigcontext.h asm/siginfo.h asm/signal.h asm/stat.h  asm/statfs.h asm/swab.h  asm/types.h asm/unistd.h
